title: VHDL-2008 case? matching with `-` don't-care choices
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: case? statement with three wildcarded arms: '10--' catches 1000..1011, '0-01' catches 0001/0101 via a middle wildcard, and '1111' is an exact final arm. others falls through to '00'. Verifies both parser acceptance of `case?`/`is?` and interpreter's element-wise wildcard match.
